description: This file defines a custom ArrayAdapter called StableArrayAdapter for an Android application. It manages a list of strings with stable item IDs and attaches touch listeners to each list item view for handling swipe motions.

classes.name: StableArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for handling list items with stable IDs and touch listeners for swipe gestures.

methods.name: StableArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with context, resource ID, list of objects, and a touch listener. It also maps each object to its index for stable IDs.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at the given position based on the mapping.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter has stable item IDs.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Manages view creation for each list item and attaches a touch listener to handle swipe events.
